steps: Fingerprint device, APK, package, and SDK.
expected: Authorized API 24+ device and valid package.
observation: Authorized SM-A566B on API 36. ARM64 debug split installed after universal transfer interruption; final universal APK rebuilt successfully.

steps: Clear permission state, launch, request and grant camera.
expected: Prompt appears once and camera opens.
observation: First-run prompt was shown; foreground grant opened the cup camera.

steps: Revoke, deny, open Settings, grant, and retry.
observation: Denied state showed camera permission error. Settings grant plus Retry reopened the camera.

steps: Observe cup ring, residue effect, and automatic capture.
expected: Existing cup visuals and readiness behavior remain.
observation: Operator directly observed residue effect. Correct first alignment auto-captured; a farther second alignment showed effect without auto-capture because ready conditions were not met.

steps: Capture cup, inspect crop preview, retake, and approve.
expected: Crop preview is usable and retake returns to cup.
observation: Cup crop preview rendered; retake returned to the live cup camera and a second capture was accepted.

steps: Approve cup capture.
observation: Every approved cup proceeded to 2/2 Saucer; no direct skip to analysis was observed.

steps: Observe saucer overlay and residue effect.
observation: Saucer target, green state, residue points and scan visuals were visible.

steps: Capture saucer, inspect crop preview, retake, and approve.
observation: Saucer preview exposed Retake and Approve; retake was exercised in the recorded first flow.

steps: Complete the two-stage route and wait for analysis.
expected: Cup capture, saucer capture, cup analysis, saucer analysis.
observation: Three complete runs ended with separate cup and saucer pipeline results in the normative sequence.

steps: Inspect final result timing fields.
Rapidly tap capture during the first flow.
observation: Rapid repeated tap produced one preview and one result; no duplicate route or analysis was observed.

steps: Physical cup failure injection.
expected: Cup failure must stop saucer analysis.
observation: No production fault injection exists. Passing automated evidence: cup failure prevents saucer analysis.

steps: Physical saucer failure injection.
observation: No production fault injection exists. Passing automated evidence: saucer failure preserves successful cup result and duration.

steps: Physical saucer retry injection.
observation: No production fault injection exists. Passing automated evidence: retry after saucer failure reruns only saucer.

steps: Background/resume cup camera, saucer camera, and final-analysis transition.
expected: No crash, stale route, or duplicate operation.
observation: Camera client closed on HOME and reopened on resume at both stages. Approval followed by immediate HOME returned to a successful two-result state.

steps: Back from cup camera and saucer camera, then cancel full route.
expected: Safe cancellation with expected preserved state.
observation: Cup cancel returned idle. Saucer back returned to preserved cup preview; second back cancelled fully.

steps: Physically rotate device in saucer camera.
expected: UI stays portrait and remains operational.
observation: Sensor desired ROTATION_270 while app remained ROTATION_0; UI hierarchy rotation stayed 0 and route remained responsive.

steps: Perform three complete flows.
observation: Three runs produced successful cup and saucer results with separate durations.

steps: Inspect media.camera after success, cancellation, and final exit.
observation: All post-exit and post-cancel dumps show Active Camera Clients: [].

steps: Compare frozen package SHA-256 inventories and rerun checks.
expected: Zero production file differences and all tests pass.
observation: coffee_camera 177 files, 0 differences, 85/85 tests. coffee_vision 84 files, 0 differences, 284/284 tests.

steps: Evaluate all executable Android items.
observation: All executable Android checks passed; no reproducible integration defect or crash was found.

steps: Execute physical iOS validation.
observation: Windows host has no macOS/Xcode environment. This approved non-blocking item was not executed.
